title: Shift Merge
commonMistakes: Comparing each shift only with the shift immediately before it instead of the current merged block
Treating touching shifts such as [1, 4] and [4, 5] as separate
Forgetting to sort the input before merging
Emitting the last merged block twice
followUps: How would you count the maximum number of shifts that overlap at once?
What changes if shifts are half-open intervals, [start, end)?
How would you merge shifts as they arrive in a stream?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
